Dashboard.title: Smart Tourist Safety System
Dashboard.subtitle: Select your portal to continue. The Government Official Dashboard provides real-time monitoring, while the App Simulator lets you generate test data and simulate tourist activity.
Dashboard.liveDashboardDesc: Access the command center. Monitor live tourist locations, view real-time safety heatmaps, and respond instantly to SOS alerts and generated anomalies.
Dashboard.appSimulatorDesc: Test the system as a tourist. Create mock accounts, generate synthetic location data, trigger artificial anomalies, and raise simulated SOS alerts.
Dashboard.footer: © {year} Smart Tourist Safety System. All Rights Reserved.

DashboardInfo.title: Smart Tourist Safety System
DashboardInfo.subtitle: Live Dashboard - Monitoring & Control
DashboardInfo.liveSimulationDesc: View real-time tourist movements and activities on an interactive map.
DashboardInfo.touristLiveLogsDesc: Monitor logs of all tourist activities and system interactions as they happen.
DashboardInfo.touristHeatMapDesc: Analyze tourist density and identify popular hotspots with a dynamic heat map.
DashboardInfo.alertOnMapDesc: Receive real-time anomaly alerts and SOS notifications directly on the map.
DashboardInfo.sosAnomalyLogDesc: Highlight tourists in distress with red ripples on the map and detailed log entries.
DashboardInfo.govOfficialDesc: Sign in to access advanced administrative controls, manage alerts, and communicate with security personnel.
